ONE variable across arms = the tie-break METHOD (rules/graph/search/coverage/CI/do-calculus identical; the DERIVED partition is byte-identical across modes). GUARDRAIL = gold_only subset acc preserved >= 0.95 (clean single-candidate wins untouched). Fixed chance = mean(1/n_choices) over the derived subset (NOT the old 1/int(mean) quirk). Held-out ARC-Challenge test; science rules NOT derived from test labels. CAN-FAIL pre-registered: TIE rise < +0.03 = the DECISION is meaning-bound (which valid derivation actually ANSWERS the question needs grounded question-relevance meaning) -> HONEST-NEG, isolated.
